cells.S26: ACME), Tie back sleeve (PPA Co, 29#, L-80, Length: 1.80 m, ID:7-3/8", OD:8-1/4") Check running tools rotating function f/ LG; OK. RIH w/ 1 Std 6-1/2"DCs & 2 Stds 5" HWDP & followed by
cells.S28: Sting in previous TBS; Obs. Hold 200 psi. Pump off, Sting in fully in previous Tie back sleeve while Obs. seals drag. Apply 25 Klb on packer to set slips; Obs shearing indication of the shear
cells.S29: pins on M/D, Apply 45 Klb more (Totally 70 Klb) on packer & keep for 10 min. P/U string to max 20 klbs overpull & Pull test; "Ok". S/O 10 Klbs on PKR & Rotate string 17 forward turn &
cells.S30: released running tools. P/U String without overpull. (New 7" L.Lap@ 3286.5m)
cells.S31: POOH w/ SN Packer running tools f/ 3286.5 to 2300m, F/U the well; NL-NG.

events.english: The source describes setting a seal-nipple packer/tie-back assembly and labels the new 7-inch liner lap at 3,286.5 m. Programme p.19 lists the pre-workover 7-inch liner from 3,285 m; that is a different description, not proof of a discrepancy. Depth datum, assembly tally and signed tests need reconciliation before accepting an as-built barrier. [AZNS-012 Workover Program Rev02.pdf, p.19]
events.persian: منبع نصب مجموعه پکر نیپل آب‌بندی و بازبست و مرجع هم‌پوشانی جدید آستری ۷ اینچ در ۳۲۸۶٫۵ متر را شرح می‌دهد. صفحه ۱۹ برنامه ابتدای آستری ۷ اینچ پیش از تعمیر را ۳۲۸۵ متر فهرست می‌کند؛ این توصیفی متفاوت است نه اثبات مغایرت. مبنای عمق، فهرست مجموعه و آزمون‌های امضاشده برای پذیرش مانع نهایی باید تطبیق شوند. [AZNS-012 Workover Program Rev02.pdf، صفحه ۱۹]

cells.S24: Spot 60 bbl Non-Solid brine in 5" LNR & 7" LNR as balance. POOH to 3515m. Displace the well w/ 800 bbl 84 pcf Non-Solid brine. Meanwhile add 1% Vol Corrosion Inhibitor, 0.5 % Vol
cells.S25: H2S Scavenger & O2 Scavenger to Non-Solid brine. Got 60 bbl contaminated w/mud on return.
cells.S26: Perform flow check; " Static".
cells.S27: Resume POOH w/ OEDPs to 2430 m & L/D Totally 162 Jts 5" DP till M.N, F/U the well; NL-NG. Meanwhile Flow check @ 3000m; Static.
cells.S30: Brine Properties, In; TSS: 17-24, Turbidity: 17-24, PH: 9.3-9.5         -            Out; TSS: 125, Turbidity: 120, PH: 9.1

events.english: The page reports displacement with 800 bbl of 84 pcf non-solid brine, 60 bbl contaminated return and a static flow-check label. Volumes and fluid properties require reconciliation with the fluid ledger and sampling records.
events.persian: صفحه جابه‌جایی با ۸۰۰ بشکه آب‌نمک بدون جامد ۸۴ پوند بر فوت مکعب، ۶۰ بشکه برگشت آلوده و برچسب ایستا برای کنترل جریان را گزارش می‌کند. حجم‌ها و خواص با دفتر سیال و سوابق نمونه‌گیری باید تطبیق شوند.

cells.S24: P/U & M/U TR3SV Assy on string. Connect control line and Press test to 5000 psi for 15min; "OK". Bleed of Press. to 3000 psi, M/U 1 Jt 4-1/2" TBG and RIH to 3295m.
cells.S25: Line up surface test Line to string. Perform Press. test completion string & TR3SV Assy against SSD Check valve w/ 4500 psi for 15min; "Ok".
cells.S26:
Bleed of control line Press to Zero. And try to OprateTR3SV flapper after several times finally "Ok".  Monitor for any Press build up as inflow test of flapper "ok". Check & Test Equalizing Function of TR3SV; "OK". M/U & RIH 5Jts 4-1/2" TBG to 3335m, M/U  4-1/2" Fluted Swage (18.9# TPCQ-EX Pin Up X HSM3 Pin Down) & TBG HGR (MSP, 11" Bowl X 4 1/2" ACME Box up X 4 1/2" TPCQ-EX Box Down, 2 Set O-Ring on Body & 2 Set O-Ring on Extended neck) on Strg. Pass C/L through Fluted Swage Slots, Check the Seals on Hanger Body, Clean threads on feed through Control Line Prior to RIH, Apply Light oil on the Seals body of tubing Hanger, Check Press. in 1/4" CL. Release CL Pressure & Cut CL approx 15m or enough to Reach to the rig floor on spool & turns around fluted Swage Below tubing Hanger, Feed all lines through tubing Hanger, Install 1/4" Fitting on C/L.
>> Pressure test of CL w/4500psi for 15min "Ok" Release Press. to 3000psi
cells.S30: Press. Test completion string against Tubing Hanger @ 3345m w/ 4600 psi for 15min; "Ok".

events.english: The page records control-line, completion-string and safety-valve checks with source-labelled OK results. The complete signed test record and subsequent changes are needed before accepting a present-barrier claim.
events.persian: صفحه کنترل‌های خط فرمان، رشته تکمیل و شیر ایمنی را با نتیجه مطلوب در منبع ثبت می‌کند. برای پذیرش ادعای مانع کنونی، گزارش کامل امضاشده و تغییرات بعدی لازم‌اند.

cells.S24: RIH W/ 3.437" Protection sleeve to 50m (11m above TR3SV), Took WT, Try to Pass this point "No succ.", POOH to Surf. Change Protection sleeve with another one  3.437" Protection sleeve, Run Back W/ Same to  50m and Took WT again, POOH and RIH w/ 3.430" Gauge Ring to 59m ( 2m above TR3SV) "Ok", POOH to Surf. and RIH w/ 3.5" GS Pulling to same Point (50m), Try to Pass "No succ.". Decided to POOH and Check string.
cells.S26:
L/D  4-1/2" Landing Joint, POOH Compl. String to 3326m while B/O & L/D 4-1/2" Fluted Swage & TBG HGR + 5jt 4-1/2" TBG, R/U Slick Line Equip., RIH w/ 3.437" Protection sleeve to TR3SV and Checked same in Position "Ok", Retrieve 3.437" Protection sleeve, R/D Slick Line Equip.
>> OBS. Debris & Coating inside first 4-1/2" TBG above TR3SV.
cells.S28:
Change 5jts 4-1/2" TBG above TR3SV , M/U 5jts New 4-1/2" TBG and Run Back W/ Compl. String to 3335m, M/U  4-1/2" Fluted Swage (18.9# TPCQ-EX Pin Up X HSM3 Pin Down) & TBG HGR (MSP, 11" Bowl X 4 1/2" ACME Box up X 4 1/2" TPCQ-EX Box Down, 2 Set O-Ring on Body & 2 Set O-Ring on Extended neck) on Strg. Pass C/L through Fluted Swage Slots, Check the Seals on Hanger Body, Clean threads on feed through Control Line Prior to RIH, Apply Light oil on the Seals body of tubing Hanger, Check Press. in 1/4" CL. Release CL Pressure & Cut CL approx 15m or enough to Reach to the rig floor on spool & turns around fluted Swage Below tubing Hanger, Feed all lines through tubing Hanger, Install 1/4" Fitting on C/L.
>> Pressure test of CL w/4500psi for 15min "Ok" Release Press. to 3000psi.
cells.S32: Line up surface test Line to string. Perform Press. test completion string & TR3SV Assy against SSD Check valve w/ 5000 psi for 15min; "Ok".

events.english: After difficulty passing the protection sleeve, the source reports debris/coating inside tubing above the safety valve, replacement of five joints and a later source-labelled pressure test. This does not independently establish root cause or current internal condition.
events.persian: پس از دشواری عبور غلاف محافظ، منبع وجود خرده و پوشش داخل لوله بالای شیر ایمنی، تعویض پنج شاخه و آزمون فشار بعدی با نتیجه مطلوب را ثبت می‌کند. علت ریشه‌ای یا وضعیت داخلی کنونی مستقلاً احراز نمی‌شود.

cells.S24: RIH & Set 3.437" Protection sleeve in TR3SV, RIH w/ 3" SB Pulling, try to Engage & Retrieve 2.75" WFB Check valve from SSD "No Succ." POOH to Surf. Change 3" SB Pulling and Run Back to Work on Retrieve 2.75" WFB Check valve, Stopped Operation Due to Slick Line Truck Hydraulic Sys. Failure.
cells.S26: While Wait on OEOC Slick Line Service Due to Hydraulic Sys. Failure, Work On it and fix same "Ok".
cells.S27: Cont. RIH w/  3" SB Pulling and try to Engage & Retrieve 2.75" WFB Check valve from SSD Several times "No Succ.", POOH to Surf.
cells.S28: M/U Slick Line BOP & Lubricator above Golpa. Flange on string, Closed Hydrill and L/U to Ann., Try to Perform Reverse Circ. "No Succ."  OBS. Build up SPP To max. 150psi and "No return from string," Checked Surface Lines "Ok".
cells.S30: While Work on Retrieve 2.75" WFB Check valve from SSD, RIH w/ 1.87" Bailers to SSD Depth (3317m) and Clean settled debris on top of  2.75" WFB Check valve @ three Run, RIH w/ 3" SB Pulling, try to Engage & Retrieve 2.75" WFB Check valve from SSD "No Succ."

events.english: The source describes unsuccessful check-valve retrieval, a slickline hydraulic failure and an unsuccessful reverse-circulation attempt with no return. This page alone does not establish the final disposition of the check valve.
events.persian: منبع تلاش ناموفق بازیابی شیر یک‌طرفه، خرابی هیدرولیک اسلیک‌لاین و گردش معکوس ناموفق بدون برگشت را شرح می‌دهد. این صفحه به‌تنهایی وضعیت نهایی شیر را تعیین نمی‌کند.

cells.S24: POOH W/ 3" JDC Pulling to Surface, Checked 3" JDC Nose & Body "OK", Run Back w/ 1-1/2" CT & same 3" JDC Pulling again and work on to Pass TR3SV Depth (61m) "No Succ.", POOH to Surf., Change 3" JDC Pulling with 3" SB Pulling, Meanwhile Closed Hydrill and L/U to Ann., Perform Reverse Circ. (Vol: 15BBls w/Max. 150psi.) "OK" RIH w/ 3" SB Pulling + Knuckle Jt to 61m, Pass this poit w/o any drag, Cont. RIH to 3295m (Traveling JT Depth), Took WT, Try to Pass " No Succ.", POOH to surface, L/D CT BOP & Injector Head, R/D OEOC CT.
cells.S26: R/U Slick line, M/U SL BOP & Lubricator above Golpa. Flange on string, RIH w/  3" SB Pulling Engage with 2.75" WFB Check valve and Catch same, Try to Retrieve from SSD Several times " No succ.", POOH to Surf. Run Back w/ 3" SB Pulling to 3317m (SSD Depth) Meanwhile Closed Hydrill and L/U to Ann., Perform Reverse Circ. (Vol: 15BBls w/Max. 150-200psi.) Engage & Retrieve  2.75" WFB Check valve  from SSD "Successfully".
cells.S28: RIH w/ 2.75" Plug to 3345m (No-Go depth),  Set Plug in No-Go L/N. POOH to surface. RIH w/ 2" prong to 3345m (No-Go depth) & Set in No-Go L/N. POOH to surface. RIH w/ 2.8" B Shifting tools to 3317m (SSD Depth) Check SSD is full close & drift string. POOH to surface. R/D Slick line equipment.

events.english: After earlier unsuccessful attempts, the report states the 2¾-inch WFB check valve was retrieved successfully, then records setting a plug and prong and checking SSD closure. This is a source-reported outcome; acceptance and present barrier status require the full signed records.
events.persian: پس از تلاش‌های ناموفق پیشین، گزارش بازیابی موفق شیر یک‌طرفه WFB به اندازه ۲¾ اینچ و سپس نصب پلاگ و پرونگ و کنترل بسته‌بودن SSD را ثبت می‌کند. این نتیجه گزارش‌شده منبع است؛ پذیرش و وضعیت کنونی مانع به سوابق کامل امضاشده نیاز دارند.

cells.S24: L/D SL BOP, Lubricator & Golpa Flange, Change TDS Link & Elevator, Line up surface test Line, Try to Press test same "No Succ.", Work on Leakage and Perform Press. Test Finally "Ok", L/U surface test Line to string. Set PKR as per procedure and increase Press Gradually to 3500 psi (Obs. Set PKR indication). Increase Press to 4500 psi as completion string Press test; "Ok". Release Press. Perform pull test w/15 klbs overpull; "OK". S/O 35Klbs Wt. and Obs. Back flow from string after expansion joint pins sheared. Land TBG hanger in THS. Tighten all Tie- Down Screws. Close Hy-drill and Press 'test Tie-Downs to 1000 psi, "OK". Line up surface test line to string. Perform Press test completion string to 4500 psi for 15 min as final completion string test; "OK", L/U to 9-5/8" Ann. try to Perform Press test several times "Not OK", OBS Leakage From Surface Line.

events.english: The page reports packer-setting indication, pull and final completion-string tests labelled OK, followed by an unsuccessful annulus-test attempt with a surface-line leak. Separate later source evidence must be considered; the excerpt is not a current well-integrity certificate.
events.persian: صفحه نشانه نصب پکر و آزمون کشش و آزمون نهایی رشته تکمیل با نتیجه مطلوب و سپس تلاش ناموفق آزمون فضای حلقوی همراه نشتی خط سطحی را گزارش می‌کند. شواهد بعدی باید جداگانه بررسی شوند؛ این گزیده گواه سلامت کنونی چاه نیست.

cells.S24: Work on Surface Line Leakage "Ok", Perform 9-5/8" Ann. Press test to 2000 psi Finally "OK". R/U Slick line & Retrieve 3.437" Protection Sleeve of TR3SV "OK". Bleed off CL Press to zero & Close TR3SV,  Back off L/J & TBG HGR Running tools f/ TBG HGR. B/O & L/D same. Install 4" 10k TWCV. Pass 1/4" Plugged CL f/ BOP Stack while L/D Mouse hole. Press test 4" 10K TWCV against SBR to 4500 psi; "OK".
cells.S26: N/D 13-5/8" BOP Stack; 5K Ann Preventer, 10K 2-7/8" X 5" VBR Top Rams + 10K SBR Middle Rams, Drlg Spool,10K 5" Fix BTM Rams & Spacer Spool. Disconnect all hydraulic hoses, Choke lines & Kill lines.
cells.S28: N/U & Install 11" X 4 1/16"-5K BTM master valve, Tighten BMV Bolts. In order to energize & Press test FS Seal of TBG HGR. L/U pump truck to BMV. Press test FS Seal of THG HGR w/4500 psi for 15/5 min; "Ok".

events.english: The last recognized page reports an annulus test finally labelled OK, work on the lower wellhead and release of named services. Service-release entries are not in themselves a rig-release time, approved final well handover or present barrier condition.
events.persian: آخرین صفحه شناسایی‌شده آزمون فضای حلقوی با نتیجه نهایی مطلوب در منبع، کار روی بخش پایینی سرچاهی و ترخیص خدمات نام‌برده را گزارش می‌کند. ترخیص خدمات به‌تنهایی زمان ترخیص دکل، تحویل نهایی مصوب یا وضعیت کنونی موانع نیست.
